validation.passwordLength: Use 10 to 128 characters, or leave empty to generate one.
validation.empCode: Use letters, digits, '-', '_' or '/' (up to 32 characters).
validation.mobile: Enter a valid mobile number (10 to 15 digits).
validation.rejected: The server did not accept this value. Check it and try again.
validation.radius: Enter a whole number from 30 to 500.
validation.range: Enter a whole number within the allowed range.
validation.appVersion: Use three numbers separated by dots, for example 1.4.0.
validation.grace: Enter a whole number from 0 to 120.
validation.hours: Enter hours above 0 and up to 24, with at most two decimals.
validation.endAfterStart: The shift must end after it starts on the same day.
validation.halfOverFull: Half-day hours cannot be more than full-day hours.
validation.decimalRange: Enter a number within the allowed range.
validation.reviewBelowVerify: The review threshold must be below the verify threshold.
validation.brightnessOrder: The minimum brightness must be below the maximum.
validation.overrideReason: Give a reason of at least 5 characters.
validation.timeSameDay: Choose a time on the same day as the punch.
validation.cutoffTime: Enter a time as HH:MM, for example 23:59.

settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: Only a Super Admin can change settings. You can view them here.

help.geofence_default_radius_m: Used for a new branch when no radius is given. 30 to 500 m.
help.home_default_radius_m: Used for a new home work location when no radius is given. 30 to 500 m.
help.gps_max_accuracy_m: A punch is refused when the phone reports a weaker fix than this. 5 to 500 m.
help.geofence_accuracy_buffer_cap_m: The most that GPS inaccuracy may widen a geofence. 0 to 100 m.
help.punch_out_approval_levels: How many managers must approve a punch-out.
help.regularization_approval_levels: How many managers must approve an attendance correction.
help.min_app_version: Older versions of the mobile app are asked to update. Format 1.4.0.
help.face_verify_threshold: A selfie scoring at or above this is accepted automatically. Match score 0.2 to 0.9.
help.face_review_threshold: From here up to the verify threshold an admin decides; below it is a mismatch. 0.1 to 0.8, below the verify threshold.
help.face_min_detection_confidence: How sure the detector must be that it sees a face. 0.5 to 0.99.
help.face_min_face_px: Face width in the photo after it is resized to 640 px. Smaller faces are retaken. 40 to 400.
help.face_min_sharpness: Blurrier photos are retaken. Higher is stricter. 1 to 2000.
help.face_min_brightness: Darker photos are retaken (average grey of the face). 0 to 254, below the maximum.
help.face_retention_days_after_exit: Photos and templates are deleted this many days after an employee is deactivated. 0 to 365.
help.attendance_cutoff_time: After this time a day is closed: no more punches, and a missing punch-out is marked. HH:MM, IST.
help.punch_reminder_after_shift_end_min: An employee still punched in is reminded this long after the shift ends. 0 to 240.
help.punch_out_request_expiry_hours: An out-of-office punch-out request nobody decided expires after this long. 1 to 240.
help.punch_max_speed_kmh: A punch that implies a faster trip from the last one goes to review. 20 to 1000.
help.offline_punch_max_age_hours: A punch made offline is refused if the phone says it is older than this. 1 to 24.
help.task_default_site_radius_m: Used for a new task when no radius is given. 30 to 500 m.
help.task_accept_escalation_minutes: The assigner is told when someone has not accepted a task after this long. 5 to 1440.
